product: PULSO — Central de Operação e Inteligência
decisions: PULSO is the sole primary brand; Eleitor CRM and Eleitor no Mapa are not competing identities.
The core demo synchronizes WhatsApp input with visible product outcomes to prove causality.
Gold is reserved for energy, focus and selected state; navy and sand carry the interface.
Atmospheric territorial imagery and restrained navy/gold/emerald gradients create depth behind high-contrast content; foreground UI remains crisp and native.
Operational diagrams use curved semantic paths, duotone module icons and one emphasized live state instead of generic glowing node constellations.
Marketing headlines may use Cormorant Garamond; application UI and data always use Inter.
Demo data is synthetic and visibly labeled; personal identifiers are masked by default.
AI conclusions show source and time, require human approval for consequential actions and never infer political preference.
Responsive layouts recompose into readable surfaces; phone mocks are never scaled down into illegibility.
